# Lottie animation library

Drop free, commercial-licensed JSON files here from lottiefiles.com
(filter to "Free" — these carry the Simple License, commercial use, no
attribution needed). Save each with EXACTLY these filenames so the
Scene Designer's closed vocabulary matches:

- checkmark.json      (a checkmark drawing/success animation)
- loading.json         (a spinner/loading animation)
- success_burst.json   (a celebratory burst/confetti/star effect)
- arrow_flow.json       (an arrow or flow/process animation)
- chat_pop.json         (a chat bubble / notification pop)
- warning_pulse.json    (a warning/alert pulse)
- growth_chart.json     (a bar/line chart growing)
- gear_spin.json        (gears turning / automation)

How to get one:
1. Go to lottiefiles.com, search e.g. "checkmark"
2. Filter results to "Free"
3. Open an animation you like, click Download > Lottie JSON
4. Rename the downloaded file to match the list above
5. Upload/copy it into this folder on the server

Any name not in this list will be ignored by the Scene Designer.
